rules: Continue an active implementation PR before opening later core-lane or child-lane scope.
Do not advance the current child until its acceptance criteria and required checks are green.
Do not mutate, relabel, overwrite or rerun frozen scored/negative evidence merely to improve the recorded result.
Public pull-request CI must not execute on the owner home self-hosted runner.
Provider/model calls must be owner-triggered and bounded by a frozen experiment contract; portable CI remains provider-free.
G8 issue #119 remains closed with owner REJECT + PIVOT; do not reopen humanoid direct-authoring expansion.
P11-X0 and P11-X1 are retained useful research. P11-X2, P11-X3, P11-B0, P11-B1 and P11-P0 are superseded as active standalone-product work by P12 and must not continue automatically.

TracePixel is not the owner of an Asset Studio, showroom, general asset library, provider marketplace or broad game-sprite production product. That product responsibility belongs to Trace2D issue #318.
Do not duplicate Trace2D SPP0-SPP5 generic processing, extraction, QA/repair, import or provider-neutral generation orchestration merely to preserve TracePixel scope.
TracePixel-direct is research infrastructure and an optional control/precision-edit path, not a privileged production generator.

P12-R0 completed the provider-free, feature-free responsibility diff in docs/P12_R0_RESPONSIBILITY_DIFF.md and froze protected-region precision editing with exact collateral-damage evidence as the sole candidate hypothesis.

P12-R1 is provider-free and feature-free until a matched precision-edit experiment, source identities, allowed/protected regions, alternatives, budgets, stop rules, artifacts and separate metrics are preregistered.
When state is awaiting-owner-review, stop provider work, surface exact artifacts/evidence and use the retained P11-X1/P7 owner-feedback protocol.
Deterministic QA green never implies aesthetic/product PASS; subjective quality remains perceptual/human.
Do not implement an autonomous aesthetic-score-until-threshold regeneration loop.
Promote a TracePixel technique into Trace2D only when matched evidence shows a practical advantage for the Trace2D Asset Studio or another explicit product workflow.
If P12 cannot demonstrate a unique practical advantage, preserve the repository as research evidence and archive/stop expansion rather than inventing a new product reason.
